children.label: un_agencies
children.description: UN agencies are specialized organizations within the United Nations system that conduct or are evaluated in humanitarian responses, focusing on global issues such as health, education, and emergency relief.

children.label: international_ngos
children.description: International NGOs are non-governmental organizations that operate across multiple countries, providing humanitarian assistance and being evaluated for their effectiveness in crisis response and development projects.

children.label: local_ngos
children.description: Local NGOs are non-governmental organizations that operate within a specific country or region, often providing community-based humanitarian assistance and being evaluated for their impact and sustainability.

children.label: government_agencies
children.description: Government agencies are national or local governmental bodies that are involved in humanitarian responses, either through direct action or policy-making, and are evaluated for their effectiveness and coordination with other actors.
example_papers: Evaluation of the Government of  Seychelles & United Nations  Strategic Partnership Framework (SPF) 2019-2023

children.label: private_sector_actors
children.description: Private sector actors are companies and businesses that contribute to humanitarian efforts through donations, resources, or direct involvement in relief operations, and are evaluated for their impact and ethical practices.
